title: Localized Besicovitch density theorem in an open set
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, W ⊆ ℝ^P open, s ⊆ ℝ^P Borel, and ν a Borel measure on ℝ^P with ν(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ W. Then for ν⌞s-almost every x ∈ ℝ^P (ν⌞s = ν.restrict s) the following holds: if x ∈ W, then for every real a < 1 there is t₀ > 0 with a·ν(B_t(x)) ≤ ν(s ∩ B_t(x)) for all t ∈ (0, t₀). Here B_t(x) is the closed ball and a is entered via ENNReal.ofReal.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (W s : Set (Euclid P)) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)), IsOpen W → MeasurableSet s → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ W → ν K ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂ν.restrict s, x ∈ W → ∀ a : ℝ, a < 1 → ∀ᶠ t in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), ENNReal.ofReal a * ν (closedBall x t) ≤ ν (s ∩ closedBall x t)
